notes: Skill enforces the absolute-path step (eval 3): clean refusal vs. baseline silently expanding ~ and writing a generic statsmodels plan.
Skill drives users into pyrsm.model.regress on polars rather than the default statsmodels-on-pandas pattern (evals 1, 2).

Skill produces the pedagogical interpretation template — units from sidecar, F-test H0/Ha, per-coefficient verdicts at the 5% level, 'holding constant' qualifier, exact 100*(exp(beta)-1)% for log-response dummies (evals 1, 2).

Skill costs ~2x tokens and ~2x wall-clock time vs. baseline, primarily because it does sidecar discovery + reference reads + structured explanation rather than jumping straight to a default OLS recipe.

Environment caveat: subagents could not execute Python (Bash for `uv run python` was denied), so the catalog baseline produced no artifacts and PNGs were not rendered for the diamonds runs. Re-running iteration 2 with execution permitted would let us confirm these qualitative differences against a baseline that actually fits a model.
